_comment: Provenance for the LAPT (language-adaptive pretraining) corpora consumed by scripts/run_table2.sh. These files are large plain-text corpora derived from external sources; they are not committed, so this manifest is the record of what a given run was trained on. Verify with: sha256sum data/lapt/<lang>.txt

amharic.provenance: Base corpus (200,000 lines) restored from VEXMLM_Official/datasets/raw/amharic/amharic.txt, sha256-verified byte-identical to the file recorded in this project's historical experiment.json artifacts (b5d5b1da90d3fff680d083dcab7ad8416037665e7762c99a2826b53ef8a849e1). Supplemented 2026-09-18 with 4,137 deduplicated lines: 2,029 unique Amharic values from HornMT (~/LLAMA3_M/HornMT.json, data.amh field) and 2,108 unique lines from FLORES-200 Amharic (amseg/data/evaluation/flores200/amharic_flores_{dev,devtest}.am and amseg/data/evaluation/amharic/test.am).
amharic.verification: hash-verified against a historical record for the 200,000-line base; the 4,137-line supplement is newly added and has no prior record.
amharic.supplement_rationale: Raised gradient coverage of the 198 new Amharic tokens from 101/198 (51.0%) to 110/198 (55.6%). See IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md sections 5b-ii and 5b-iii.
amharic.notes: FLORES-200 is a public Meta AI benchmark release. Ge'ez text from amseg (geez_corpus.txt, mt_combined.txt) was deliberately excluded: it is classical/liturgical Ge'ez, a different language from Amharic despite the shared script.

tigrinya.provenance: Copied from VEXMLM_Official/datasets/raw/tigrinya/tigrinya.txt, selected on directory-convention match with the Amharic corpus and a matching filesystem timestamp (Aug 5 14:00).
tigrinya.verification: NOT hash-verified. Unlike Amharic, no historical experiment.json record of a Tigrinya LAPT corpus hash exists in this repository, so there is nothing to verify this file against. It is the most plausible candidate, not a confirmed match. Any Tigrinya result produced from it should carry this caveat.
tigrinya.notes: See IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md section 5d. Restored 2026-09-18 after the file was found missing despite being referenced by logs/t2_tigrinya_{tc,ner,qa}.sbatch.
